title: Declare the platform-only steward-hook tests as skips
summary: Tests only. The consumer guard and context binding tests of `@inventarch/steward-hook` that returned early on Windows now declare a skip there (the file-link cases only where Windows denies the link), and a new test covers a code file replaced by a directory after its directory is listed. Nothing changes for consumers: the package's code, behavior and API are the same.
